title: Act: Render loading, error, empty states in the pill and group icon controls
summary: Move state branches into the pill with data-state and group the icons.
description: Change the ternary in HeaderOverlay so each state is inside the sf-pill and the icon buttons sit in a group. Done after ACT1 in the same file.
acceptance_criteria: Each state has a pill with data-state.
Icon buttons are inside a role group labelled Header controls.

steps.action: Make error branch: Round unavailable: {error} followed by the existing Retry Button when onRetry is set. Loading: Loading round…. Empty: No active round. Ready pill gets data-state="ready".
steps.expected: Every state is rendered in a pill with data-state.

steps.action: Wrap the sound and settings Buttons in <div role="group" aria-label="Header controls" className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2"> and keep their aria-label, aria-pressed and onClick unchanged.
steps.expected: Both icons are in the labelled group and still toggle uiStore.
